segment_redundancy_diagnostic.method: Exact BF16 byte equality at each fixed feature position. Python hashes accelerate full byte equality only; no approximate matching or cross-position reuse is counted.
segment_redundancy_diagnostic.command_text:
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib,json,socket,time
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;R=B.parents[1]
source=json.loads((B/'existing-q7169-row-redundancy-r1.json').read_text())
start=time.monotonic();reports=[]
for prior in source['reports']:
 p=R/prior['file'];raw=p.read_bytes();digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();assert digest==prior['sha256'] and len(raw)==prior['bytes']
 rows=prior['rows'];width=len(raw)//rows//2;assert rows==7169 and width==2048
 tests=[]
 for chunk in (4,8,16,32,64,256,2048):
  groups=width//chunk;unique=[];largest=[]
  for group in range(groups):
   if time.monotonic()-start>50:raise TimeoutError('bounded segment scan')
   offset=group*chunk*2
   counts=Counter(raw[row*width*2+offset:row*width*2+offset+chunk*2] for row in range(rows))
   unique.append(len(counts));largest.append(max(counts.values()))
  tests.append(dict(k_values=chunk,positions=groups,segments=rows*groups,unique_segments=sum(unique),fraction_redundant=1-sum(unique)/(rows*groups),unique_per_position=unique,maximum_multiplicity=max(largest)))
 reports.append(dict(file=prior['file'],sha256=digest,bytes=len(raw),rows=rows,width=width,segments=tests))
 print(p.parent.name,p.name,[(x['k_values'],round(x['fraction_redundant']*100,4)) for x in tests],flush=True)
record=dict(host=socket.gethostname(),method='Exact BF16 byte equality at each fixed feature position. Python hashes accelerate full byte equality only; no approximate matching or cross-position reuse is counted.',source_report_sha256=hashlib.sha256((B/'existing-q7169-row-redundancy-r1.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),reports=reports,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,runtime_changed=False,inference_acceptance=False,performance_acceptance=False)
with (B/'existing-q7169-segment-redundancy-r1.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
